checkpoint_review: The Router correctly identified that the 'Rectangular furniture piece... notably taller than wide' checkpoint is not met. The Router was also correct to mark 'Bilateral symmetry' as missing; the composition is heavily weighted to the left with books, while the right side features a wall and lamp, breaking symmetry. The 'Multiple horizontal shelves spaced evenly' checkpoint was correctly marked false due to visible irregular spacing and perspective distortion. The Router's assessment of material and open front is accurate. I agree with all Router verdicts; no checkpoints were marked present when they should have been absent.
artifact_review: The Router identified structural collapse on the right side (severity 3), texture anomalies in books (severity 2), and perspective distortion (severity 2). I agree with these findings but believe the severity of the structural issue is underestimated. The topology_boundary_auditor mask reveals significant fragmentation and 'ghosting' artifacts on the right side (the lamp/wall area), appearing as disconnected pixel islands rather than a coherent structure. This confirms severe structural confusion beyond simple warping. Additionally, the book spines exhibit classic AI 'smearing' where text and binding details dissolve into color blocks, supporting the Router's texture anomaly finding. The perspective lines of the shelves are inconsistent, creating a non-Euclidean feel. Given the combination of structural fragmentation, perspective failure, and texture smearing, the artifact score should be lower than the formula reference suggests.
